hist_case.problem: Build V5 Cross-Domain Personal Intelligence: per-domain silos, explicit consent, audited multi-domain inference
hist_case.case_text: Fifth and last of five Communication System versions (founder-locked build order 2026-08-06/07/08). Prototype already proven 12/12 in scripts/prototype-cross-domain-v5.mjs; ports the consent/inference logic only, real data-source integration deferred.
hist_case.opportunity: Long-term moat: the same perception/conversation/action loop serves every LifeOS product and learns the user once, with real domain firewalls, not implicit trust.
